rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides observability into Valkey and Redis databases with historical analytics, slowlog pattern analysis, client connection tracking, ACL audit trails, anomaly detection, and Prometheus metrics. Includes both a web UI dashboard and MCP integration for querying database health, performance, and configuration from AI clients. Supports Valkey 8.0+ and Redis 6.0+ with automatic database type detection.
